name: Publish by hand sends only the commit its check passed on (PUBLISHING-1, 2)
description: A job done with its check passed whose pull request failed: Publish by hand sends the commit its check passed on; once its branch in obid's clone moved to a commit its check never ran on, Publish by hand answers 409 saying so and nothing reaches the remote.

args: A commit its check never ran on
